title: World Liquor 0.1.190: return stored discs on jukebox destruction
native_evidence_scope: Production callback regressions reproduce and fix stored-disc loss on Creative jukebox destruction and explosions with doTileDrops disabled. Four break cases and 21 affected audio/source cases pass. Existing native sound-instance, saved-disc, Captain Gift and death-drop observations retain their original scope and are not rerun or relabeled. No new native destruction observation, full ItemStack metadata or complete jukebox automation parity is claimed.
public_notes_inline: Jukebox destruction returns its stored custom record independently of Creative mode and doTileDrops, following Java JukeboxBlock.onRemove and JukeboxBlockEntity.popOutTheItem. The consumed saved row prevents duplicate returns, and the existing owned sound handle is stopped. Saved formats and UUIDs are unchanged.
peer_pin_note: Unchanged exact T200 dependency and G220 optional CI peer; no external effect schema or saved-data format changes. Complete-family saved-world gates and deployment remain separate.
